analogue: Aqueous guaiacol- and syringol-derived phenoxyl radical coupling through C–C or C–O bonds yields dimers and higher oligomers.
citation: Insights into secondary organic aerosol formed via aqueous-phase reactions of phenolic compounds based on high resolution mass spectrometry
evidence: Mass spectra of organics generated by aqueous phenolic oxidation showed dimer and higher oligomer products consistent with phenoxyl coupling.
difference: The analogue used identifiable methoxyphenols in water. The abundance and reactivity of condensed o-cresol-derived phenolics, particle water content, two-body rate and product persistence in the Manchester experiments remain unverified.
